description: This file defines a Java interface 'Security' that specifies authorization-related methods for security management in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for permission checks, role validation, and cache clearing, serving as a contract for security-related implementations.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Interface outlining security and permission management methods, including permission checks, role validation, and cache clearing, intended for implementation in security components of the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance, deprecated method.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the Delegator instance, deprecated method.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves security groups for a user login ID, using cache for performance, deprecated.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Checks if a security group permission exists for a given group ID and permission name, cached for efficiency, deprecated.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Overloaded methods to verify if the current session user or a specified user login has a specific permission.

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission on a specific entity and action, with support for admin shortcuts.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Several overloaded methods to verify if a user has a role-based permission within an application, possibly validating session or user login object.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Clears user-specific cached data, typically invoked upon logout.
